rules.title: Relocation Payments for No-Fault Evictions (Owner/Relative Move-in, Demolition, Capital Improvement, Substantial Rehabilitation)
rules.requirement: Landlords in San Francisco who evict tenants for owner/relative move-in, demolition or permanent removal of the unit, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation must pay relocation benefits to each tenant, with additional amounts for elderly, disabled tenants, or households with minor children.
rules.key_value: $8,245.00 per tenant; max $24,733.00 per unit; +$5,497.00 for elderly/disabled/minor-child households (3/01/26-2/28/27)
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to tenancies terminated for owner/relative move-in, demolition/permanent removal, temporary capital improvement work, or substantial rehabilitation under the San Francisco Rent Ordinance.
rules.exemptions: Temporary capital improvement evictions lasting less than 20 days are governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9, not Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.
rules.quoted_span: *The amount of relocation payments for temporary capital improvement evictions for less than 20 days is governed by California Civil Code Section 1947.9 and not by Rent Ordinance Section 37.9C.

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the eviction is based on owner/relative move-in, demolition, temporary capital improvement, or substantial rehabilitation

rules.conflict_note: Rates are updated annually; the table lists historical and current rates by effective period, current period being 3/01/26-2/28/27.

rules.title: Relocation Payments for Ellis Act Evictions
rules.requirement: Landlords who evict tenants under the Ellis Act (removing units from the rental market) must pay relocation benefits per tenant, with a maximum per unit, plus additional amounts for elderly or disabled tenants.
rules.key_value: $11,110.05 per tenant; max $33,330.13 per unit; +$7,443.90 for elderly (62+)/disabled tenants (3/01/26-2/28/27)
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to tenancies terminated under the Ellis Act (withdrawal of units from rental housing use) in San Francisco.
rules.quoted_span: Relocation payments for tenants evicted under the Ellis Act

coverage.other_unknown_factor: whether the owner has invoked the Ellis Act to remove the unit from the rental market

rules.conflict_note: Rates are updated annually; the table lists historical and current rates by effective period, current period being 3/01/26-2/28/27.
